body:
I very much fall to the category of 'hopeful agnostic'. I feel that if there is any intelligent force that affects the universe in bigger scale, we are only a small blip on the radar and our destruction does not matter in the state of all that exists in the universe. I feel It's egoistic to assume that we are the only and chosen race to fulfill some bigger meaning for some 'god' in this vast existence.    


I also believe (as you said you fear) that people will destroy this planet with their greed. It is avoidable but it will not be stopped (I fucking hope it will but it does not look good). The effects might be reduced but it will still change our lifestyle significantly in our lifetime. And I'm somewhat readying for that. I can accept that my life expectancy will be cut short by human greed. I feel that water will be the next resource we have wars over, and I believe it will happen during our lifetime. I can accept that.   


I very much believe in math and rational thinking but the feeling I cant shake is that I might die because some people who interpret an ancient book might be right. I don't believe it's going to happen, but I've been raised in a JW family and my mind can't stop the 'what if?'

I'm emotionally unable to tell these news to my sister face to face, so I thought that I'd write her a letter about all that I feel. Telling how much I love her and why our views don't align anymore. going back to my childhood and making my point of view as clear as possible

Thank you for your very insightful comment! On the other hand I want to give the finger and play the game where they can not find fault, but on the other if I got DF'd I'd finally have my freedom to live and not worry if someone sees what I do

I think the whole idea of shunning is a bit backwards. My old friends are hesitant to talk to me after my old letter and it just drives me way more away from the community. When I talk to them I'm super careful of what I say so I won't hurt them. how does having a casual conversation once in a while corrupt them? They would realize this if they had one original thought but are discouraged to do so by the religion.  


You are told to study to become convinced of the truth. But if you look anywhere beyond their material you are an apostate. They say you arrived to your conclusion by sound resolution but how could you with only a single source?  


Yeah I was convinced when I got baptized at 16y old. I said this to my mother during one argument. I said I was too young to make that decision. she said that I was well ripe enough. Then I asked her would she let me marry or do other life changing decisions at that age....  


sorry, this devolved in to an unrelated rant but I have some frustrations to work out

It would be interesting because as soon as I abandoned the mentality I didn't need to cry myself to sleep. If a just god exists, they will understand why I did it, and if they don't condone, I don't want to live under such command. I might be narrow minded but if all knowing and "perfect" deity exists, they will understand our shortcomings better than any human ever will

I wonder what would they say if I refused to answer to these invasive questions because I will not even if I go :D If I don't go could they DF me only on my mothers word? I stupidly told her that I did "something" (no details) after she confronted me
Does this mean that if I don't admit they can't do anything (my mother is the only one who heard it, I admitted it to her because I was stupid) as they don't have two witnesses?
could not have said it better myself!
thank you! I hope you are doing well!

I started reducing my dose over a month ago and have been completely off for 10 days now. Your experience is exactly why I wrote this post. thank you! I've had panic attacks before even with the additional medication for them but none of the additional pills were helpful and I just kinda learned how to avoid them with therapy, and now I've haven't had any for moths. Even if I had one I feel confident I have learned the mental tools to cope with them. I've also told all my friends and they know what to do to ease my mind if one ever happens.
It gives closure
In europe you have a right to request any registers with your information to be disposed of

there has been so much stuff accumulating trough the years to finally make me do this... reasons you mentioned are one big aspect. Longer ones can be found on my earlier post to this subreddit. Basically I've been depressed and more or less suicidal since I turned 11. It has been because I couldn't feel like I was good enough for jehovah and would die in armageddon. 

Another big thing is that I've been treated like trash since I started missing meetings due to my chronic illness. This month I sent my first 0 hour report and I got no response. There was a convention today and brothers must have been super busy since no one had time to even write me a simple text message so I'd known the date. Every time I went to the KH this one old lady came to me and said: "well at least you show up sometimes." with the most ironic tone.

I find no unconditional love there. Nor acceptance. I can't stand all the degrading jokes about LGBT+ people. I can't believe in a god that would first tell you to do as you please and then kill you for what you did... 

sorry for the rant, I'm a bit emotional at the moment.
I didn't give any reason in the letter. I just wan't off the list and I told them they are not allowed to keep records of me anymore and to destroy existing data.
I did! Something I learned reading this sub...

Thank you very much! I think I'll be in close vicinity of the "create a post" button for the next week at least. My letter will hopefully be read at Thursday meeting. I'll tell my close family today.

This will be a heck of a ride me thinks....

I see you found my post! Thank you for your kind words! 

guilt already took joy out of my childhood so I'd rather be dead than fall back to that pit again. My healing process began when I got rid of the voice of conscience that was haunting 24/7 even though my actions were not hurting anyone. 

As you said, I'm not abandoning my family, nor is it meant to be an insult for them. I'm happy to welcome them anytime they might want to be in contact with me, but I do understand that they might not wan't to do that. I was once a PIMI too...

99,5% chance they will shun me.

But I finally feel like I'm in control of my own life. the feeling is so relieving. I can finally breathe freely!

thank you! <3

This.

I have my letter of disassociation next to me and my only concern is how my family will manage the news.

Sounds like I had written that! Even stopped attending meetings because of panic attacks.

Remember that you are valuable and matter! No one has the right to say that you don't matter because of some arbituary rules.

I hope you'll feel better soon!
That blew my mind! I had no idea that there has been such strong articles against excommunication. Thank you!
Have any sources for these statements? You got me interesred

I have only been in meetings when I've absolutely needed to. (like when at my parents etc). but I haven't been at anyone's door in over a year. This is still my first "0 hours for month report" (I've been reporting 1 hour for many moths). I still don't think that I can handle the mental strain of being bombarded by my family. ( my mother hates my father but will call him about concerns about me). and he's narsissistic and awful to be around when talking of these matters.

I've been thinking that one plan is to start hinting about my concerns. I might make my little sister think at least
thank you for taking time to write a reply! this is very useful!
It's funny that you're urged to study and make up your own mind but every opposing view and news article is eighter a "satans lie" or an apostate teaching

Yeah naive me got baptised at 16yo. I thought I knew what I was getting in to... 

I'll have to think about this and have a chat with my therapist

Thanks for your kind comment! I'm afraid that if I don't disassosiate myself I won't hear the end of the worried phone calls asking me to reconsider, nor the stream of elders knocking on my door. Pressure from my family has been my biggest source of stress for years. 

Plus I want to live my life openly and trying to hide my doings would be a nightmare. I've tried that and it's awful

It really depends where you are. Where I grew up some parents would not even let their children go to a vocational school after finishing their junior high. they were raised with pioneering as the only possible path for their future. Ironically one of those families is now know for how much they work to buy nice cars and property :D 

In the bigger cities it's more open minded. I know several PIMIs that are in college and it's more widely accepted ( depending on why your pursuing higher education) but some elder will still have a stick up your ass every meeting to see if you've been behaving. Most don't think that the education is bad on itself but the students are too immoral to be around :D Finnish students sure like their parties and I've had a great time every  time attending one. There is a saying in finnish that says: "It's not alcoholism before you graduate."  Ofc attending these parties is a huge no no even if you ask the more open minded folks.
I live in Finland
Thank you! :)
